allowedInputs: current actor-choice prompt and its owner-visible choices

decisionContract.fallback: pass only when a pass token is present; otherwise abstain

rankSpecificDecisionEnvelopes.apexDragon: Select only a source-bound Dragon attack choice offered by the current owner prompt. Noivern Dominating Echo receives rank-specific priority when a Stadium or Special Energy is visible; Phantom Dive is not selected because its PutDamagePrompt allocation is unsupported.
rankSpecificDecisionEnvelopes.discardManagement: Preserve Regidrago V/VSTAR and Double Dragon/basic Energy; prefer a unique Noivern/Dialga/Koraidon/Kyurem attack payload for discard only when its matching payload is not already in the discard. Dragapult remains protected while Phantom Dive is blocked.
rankSpecificDecisionEnvelopes.megatonBlower: Only play when opponent Tools, Special Energy, or a Stadium are visible in the actor view; if own Stadium is the only Stadium, it is not a reason to play.
rankSpecificDecisionEnvelopes.pathToPeak: Withhold until own VSTAR power is spent and all relevant own Rule Box ability users are known spent; only then consider visible opponent Rule Box threats.
rankSpecificDecisionEnvelopes.counterCatcher: Use only when offered by the frontier; choose a visible high-Prize opponent Bench target.
rankSpecificDecisionEnvelopes.echoingHorn: Choose only a visible Basic Pokémon offered from opponent discard; prioritize high-Prize target if one is available.
rankSpecificDecisionEnvelopes.heavyBall: Do not infer concealed Prize identities; abstain unless a real identity is owner-visible.
